findings.title: A context.test.ts comment and fixture asserted the readiness behaviour this branch's own ADR 0034 deleted, modelling a state no account could reach
findings.arbiter_reasoning: ROUND 2 DISPOSITION: FIXED, and the replacement combination was independently PROVEN REACHABLE at HEAD rather than assumed. The test now builds `readiness.blockReasons: ['provider_moderation_not_validated']` beside `posting: { blocked: false, reasons: [] }`. Reachability: readiness' reason comes from `providerModerationValidated` (readiness.ts:42), fed by `providerModerationValidated()` = `readFlag('AUTO_APPROVAL_PROVIDER_MODERATION_READY')` (flags.ts:15-17). The Posting block's provider arm is a DIFFERENT input, `providerModerationEnabled` (posting-status.ts:62), fed by `readFlag('OPENAI_MODERATION_ENABLED')` (flags.ts:11-13). The two flags are independent env reads, so `OPENAI_MODERATION_ENABLED=true` with `AUTO_APPROVAL_PROVIDER_MODERATION_READY=false` yields exactly this pair on an otherwise-clean Autopilot account. Unlike the deleted `autopilot_unavailable` fixture, no arm of `buildAutoApprovalPostingStatus` is forced by it. The comment now states the same discriminator posting-status.ts:34 and the glossary state.

findings.title: Narrowing correctionOwed to unsolicited mention in rule 2 left rule 5's "and only when correctionOwed is true" un-narrowed, so the two rules instruct opposite things for a suspended account asked a direct question
findings.arbiter_reasoning: Fixed at 324d94b65. Confirmed a real contradiction, not an instance of the accepted chat-guided limitation: "only when X" is a necessary condition, so a suspended account with correctionOwed=false and a direct question was one reachable state receiving two opposite instructions. Unguaranteed and contradictory are different failures - the first says the model may not comply, the second means compliance is undefined. Rule 5 now defers to the same terms as rules 1 and 2; prompt version bumped to 2026-09-20.3; a new test loop forbids a bare "only when correctionOwed is true" in any Posting-block rule, and the old rule-5 text was verified to trip it.
